chapter: Trummy Young's band, 52nd Street and the Navy
title: Great Lakes: the Navy band of Willie Smith, Clark Terry and the Royals
summary: At Great Lakes he finds an all-star Navy band that invites him to join but he is unwilling.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Anyway, I went home and went for induction, passed it with flying colors, and they put me in the Navy and sent me to Great Lakes. I went up to Great Lakes, and this where Osie Johnson and Willie Smith, Clark Terry, the brothers... The first alto saxophone player with Basie and his brother.
You mean the Royals? Marshall Royal...
Marshall Royal and Ernie Royal. All of these people were up there in the band, you know. They had this band which was a dynamite little band.

I don't know whose it was. I guess it was some person that was an Army officer or something. It wasn't any of their band. They were just... But anyway, when I went up there they had this band. And immediately, they started to talk to me about coming over, and there was the opportunity for coming over and joining that band with all these people in it. I'd just left 52nd Street, and I was out here with no...you know, without that kind of discipline and all that.
